Both sit as plain top-level lines in Ejaculation frequency; the older reset line has no Later view.
findings.fix: Under the line headed by 006-21 add `  - later 731-43` (move 731-43 out of Ejaculation frequency). 731-44 can stay where it is.

findings.found: Two top-level lines of Why it matters make the same claim from different episodes: 002-39 'The more you conserve semen, the more you feel it in your hormones, life force energy and mind' and 029-50 'Conserving your semen helps in so many ways, your life force, your energy, your hormones'. 002-39 is only the dose-response form of 029-50. findings.found: 029-52 'With a partner, not ejaculating as often means learning to separate orgasm and ejaculation' and 006-43 'With a woman and regular sex, the goal still seems to be separating orgasm and ejaculation, which takes practice' make the same claim from two episodes. 029-52 heads a group (with 006-29); 006-43 is nested elsewhere, under 034-22 'harder with a partner'. 006-43 is the hedged version ('still seems').

findings.found: The claim 'retention goes with staying sexually active, not with no activity' is split across two sections. In What it is: 027-19 'most definitely not about having no sexual activity, the opposite', 002-36 'doesn't mean not having sex', 088-46 'means staying active in whatever form while retaining that energy' (under 088-04). In Retention and activity: 027-20 'as much awesome sex activity as you can have ... without ejaculating', 731-49, 731-50 and 731-51 'Hard mode, avoiding sexual activity, is not the way'. 027-19 and 027-20 are adjacent claims of one episode, and 731-51 repeats 027-19 and 002-36 with a different scope (hard mode). These groups are in two sections and never count 002, 027, 088 and 731 together.
findings.fix: Make one group in Retention and activity: head 027-20 (or 088-46), with 027-19, 002-36, 088-46, 731-49, 731-50 nested, and keep 731-51/731-53 beside it. Leave 088-02, 088-03 and 027-17 (independent of sexual activity) in What it is.
